name: 01_Administration
title: RuleSphere - Activity Diagram — 01. Administration | UC-01..04

items.text:
Authenticate and check action permissions
within Tenant / Workspace
Validate scoped membership and role assignment

Validate issuance or revocation request
and permitted credential scope
Validate reusable asset and Tenant ownership
Return validation errors without applying change
Issue scoped credential or revoke credential
Publish exact immutable Shared Library version

notes:
Cross-workspace reuse requires an exact Tenant Shared Library version.
No direct cross-workspace or cross-tenant references.

name: 02_Decision_Modeling
title: RuleSphere - Activity Diagram — 02. Author, Validate and Sandbox | UC-05..09

items.text: Create or open a Decision draft

Edit nodes, dependencies, schema versions,
sensitivity metadata and library pins
Check scope and save draft revision
Recheck authorization and load exact revision

Check DAG, reference scope, contracts
and schema compatibility
Return validity, issues and breaking-change status
Provide test input and request sandbox run

Recheck permission, current revision
and test input contract
Execute fixed draft snapshot using DAG semantics

Produce result / attributable error
and protected execution trace

notes:
Author may edit and validate again in a later request.
Breaking changes contribute to risk; they are not
automatically invalid under every compatibility policy.

Node execution semantics: diagram 06.
No effect on production traffic or deployment.

name: 03_Governance_and_Approval
title: RuleSphere - Activity Diagram — 03. Governance and Artifact Build | UC-10..14

items.text: Authorize submit and validate candidate revision
Return errors; do not enter review

Calculate risk from change scope,
schema compatibility and previous 30-day traffic
Bind candidate revision and policy; enter In Review
Submit approve / reject / upward override command

Check current scope, role, maker exclusion,
stage and candidate revision
Increase tier and re-evaluate required approvals

Append immutable approval evidence
for the reviewed revision
Mark Approved and freeze Decision Version
Verify governed revision and required validation

Build artifact binding exact graph, schemas,
dependencies and Shared Library versions
Store immutable artifact, manifest and integrity metadata
Expose artifact as eligible for delivery
Report observable build failure; no deliverable artifact
Block build and report precondition failure

notes:
Tier 1: one Domain Approver.
Tier 2: Domain Peer THEN Workspace Owner.
Tier 3: Domain Owner AND Compliance Officer.
Maker is excluded from every approval role.

Reuse of prior approvals needs explicit policy.
An edited revision cannot inherit approval implicitly.

Human review commands are separate requests over time, not an open HTTP call.
Approved does not mean Active. This activity describes governance, not a BPM engine.

name: 04_Shadow_and_Canary
title: RuleSphere - Activity Diagram — 04. Shadow and Canary Rollout | UC-15..17

items.text: Configure Shadow and/or Canary settings for candidate
Authorize rollout command and verify candidate eligibility
Authorize runtime scope and resolve routing context
Apply deterministic sticky percentage / cohort policy
Validate input and evaluate selected snapshot (see Diagram 06)
Shadow enabled and mirrored traffic eligible?
Evaluate Active snapshot on mirrored input for baseline
Use captured Active outcome as baseline
Evaluate approved Shadow snapshot on mirrored input
Both outcomes valid and protection succeeded?
Record comparison error without impacting production
Submit query for Shadow comparison diffs
Fetch protected diff records from store
Assemble divergence metrics and node reports

notes:
F-14 Resolution: Rollout configuration, production evaluation, and diff querying are decoupled.
Shadow processing is dispatched asynchronously without blocking or mutating the production response.
Canary uses deterministic sticky hash or approved cohort routing.

name: 05_Deployment_and_Convergence
title: RuleSphere - Activity Diagram — 05. Promote, Rollback and Convergence | UC-18..20, UC-27

items.text: Request promote candidate or rollback to prior version
Authorize operation and verify target eligibility
Switch desired Active pointer to target artifact
Record actor, from/to version, timestamp and reason
Acknowledge desired-state update to Release Manager
Broadcast desired-state change event to Runtime fleet
Fetch exact immutable artifact and dependency references
Verify checksum integrity and contract compatibility
Mark snapshot eligible for new incoming requests
Report loaded version, generation and healthy status
Continue serving while emitting error alert
Track desired vs loaded status from all active nodes
Expose convergence lag and alert SLA breach
Return node-by-node desired/loaded versions, lag, and errors

notes:
Rollback reuses an eligible prior immutable artifact.
No cloning or rebuild needed.

Concurrent execution across all active fleet nodes.
Zero-restart in-memory load without interrupting in-flight requests.

F-14 Resolution: Decoupled into Promotion/Rollback, Fleet Synchronization, and Operator Query.
Fleet nodes synchronize concurrently with zero restart. Failed nodes retain valid loaded artifacts (FR-DIST-004).
SLA is <=2.0s from event emission to 100% active nodes loaded and eligible (NFR-CONS-001).

name: 06_Runtime_Evaluation
title: RuleSphere - Activity Diagram — 06. REST / gRPC Evaluation | UC-21..24

items.text:
Send input, credential, routing context
and optional version pin
Find exact eligible version in local artifact store

Return REST 412 or documented gRPC
precondition error; no fallback to Active

Resolve configured sticky Canary / cohort selection
or latest eligible node-local Active

Bind graph, schemas, dependencies and libraries
as one atomic snapshot
Return client contract error before evaluation
Create execution context and trace; set healthy
Select next node in topological order
Evaluate node in fixed execution context
Record result, matched node and activated branches
Qualifying error and valid typed fallback configured?
Use fallback and record fallback use
Record attributable error and mark failed
Finalize execution outcome and trace tree

Dispatch safe asynchronous evidence capture
(details in diagram 07)

Return result, executionId
and authorized version metadata

notes:
Normal evaluation has no synchronous Control Plane dependency.
Mid-request publication never replaces the bound atomic snapshot.
Trace persistence does not block this flow; failures follow observable operational policy.

name: 07_Trace_Capture
title: RuleSphere - Activity Diagram — 07. Protected Execution Evidence | UC-24

items.text: Identify sensitive fields using bound schema metadata

Mask, tokenize or hash sensitive values
including intermediate outcomes, output and errors
Report capture degradation and apply failure policy
Attempt to persist full protected trace tree
Report affected execution, failed store and degradation

notes:
ExecutionID, DecisionVersion, InputHash,
protected Output, MatchedNodeIDs, Timestamp,
approval/release evidence reference.

This activity runs independently of the consumer response; its join only joins capture tasks.
Persistence failure must not silently change the business decision outcome.
Retry, timeouts, reliable delivery and backpressure details require ADR.
Never store plaintext sensitive fields in execution traces.

name: 08_Historical_Explain_and_Audit
title: RuleSphere - Activity Diagram — 08. Historical Explanation and Audit | UC-25..26

items.text:
Request explanation by ExecutionID
or audit inspection by filter
Authenticate and authorize action within Tenant/Workspace
Return access error without disclosing evidence

Read scoped retained hot trace
and compliance metadata
Include protected node, branch and outcome details
Read referenced evidence within authorized scope

Assemble available execution, version
and release evidence

Read scoped governance, deployment
and security audit records
Return protected evidence with retention limitations
View explanation / audit records or authorized export

notes:
Full trace may expire before compliance metadata.
Return only retained evidence; never invent missing intermediate decisions.
Queries and referenced evidence must remain within authorized scope.
